title: Compare best and mean fitness
description: You display two stored fitness histories across generations.

steps.description: You create a figure and plot best_hist with the label best. Each history entry supplies one plotted generation value.
You add mean_hist on the same axes with the label mean. Both curves share the fitness scale.

steps.question: Does a higher or lower plotted value represent better fitness on this chart?
steps.answer: The vertical label says Fitness (maximize), so higher values represent better fitness.

steps.description: You label the horizontal axis Generation and identify the objective as negative Rastrigin in two dimensions. The legend distinguishes the two histories when the chart is displayed.
